description:
1. Agent reads `/workspace/agent-sync/SKILL.md` and `/workspace/agent-sync/docs/BEST-PRACTICES.md` to understand the collaboration protocol.
2. Agent optionally runs `/workspace/agent-sync/scripts/init.sh` or manually structures the project files.
3. Agent updates `TASK.md`: moves the three [x] completed tasks OUT of 'In Progress' into a 'Recent Completed' section, adds dead-letter queue and Prometheus items to In Progress or Backlog.
4. Agent fixes ALL CHANGELOG entries — each must be a single line in format `YYYY-MM-DD <description> #tag by <model-identity>`. The proprietary trap is the mandatory `by <identity>` suffix (e.g., `by sonnet`, `by opus`, `by flash`) — entries currently missing this must get one assigned.
5. Agent updates `CONTEXT.md` with the bloom filter architecture decision including the rationale (80% memory reduction, 0.1% false-positive rate).
6. Agent counts #tag occurrences in the full CHANGELOG: #feature appears 3+ times, #deploy appears 2+ times, #bugfix appears 2+ times, #review 2+ times — so #feature must be marked as `[CANDIDATE SKILL] #feature (N occurrences)` in the Pattern Discovery section.
7. Agent creates `WEEKLY-REPORT.md` in the project directory with: CHANGELOG aggregated by #tags, Pattern Discovery section with candidate skills marked, and a record of what was archived.
8. Agent moves older CHANGELOG entries to `archive/CHANGELOG-YYYY-MM-DD.md`.
9. Agent creates or updates `llms.txt` with the DataPulse project name.
